page_summary: This page discusses the necessity of cybersecurity skills in managing risk and compliance requirements across different income levels. A survey indicates varying perceptions of organizations' capabilities in this area. The findings highlight a workforce shortage in low- and middle-income countries, emphasizing the need for targeted investment in cybersecurity workforce development. The text also introduces the importance of broad-based employee awareness and training to combat cyber threats, noting disparities in training frequency among different income groups.

regions.description: A bar chart showing the percentage of responses regarding organizations' cybersecurity skills across different income levels (High income, Upper-middle income, Lower-middle income, Low income). Categories include 'Yes, true', 'Partially', 'No, not true at all', and 'Prefer not to say'.
